verdict.rationale: Semgrep's core scanning engine/CLI is open-source, installs locally (pipx/uv), and runs analysis entirely on the user's own machine or build environment with no code upload by default — effectively self-hosted by design (semgrep-gh-2, semgrep-comm-11, semgrep-docs-26/27). However, this is inherent to the local CLI tool rather than a documented 'self-host our platform' offering; the richer AppSec Platform features (Assistant AI, Managed Scans, dashboards) remain SaaS-only with no evidence of an on-prem/self-hosted deployment option. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/on-prem deployment guide for the full platform, enterprise self-host docs, independent confirmation of self-hosted platform use.
